units.source_text: 朱雀帝让位的决心渐渐成熟。

en.t: Emperor Suzaku's resolve to abdicate gradually grew firm.

units.source_text: 但尚侍胧月夜常常愁叹今后身世之寂寥，帝心很可怜她，对她说道：

en.t: But the Naishi no Kami Oborozukiyo often lamented the loneliness that awaited her, and the Emperor pitied her deeply and said to her:

units.source_text: “你的父亲太政大臣已经故世。

en.t: "Your father, the Grand Minister, has already passed away.

units.source_text: 你的大姐皇太后病势沉重，已经少有希望。

en.t: Your eldest sister, the Empress Dowager, is gravely ill, and there is little hope left.

units.source_text: 我也觉得自己在世之日不会久长。

en.t: I too feel that my own days in this world will not last much longer.

units.source_text: 将来你孤苦伶仃地留在世间，确是怪可怜的啊！

en.t: In the future, to be left alone and helpless in this world will truly be pitiful for you.

units.source_text: 你以前爱我不及爱别人之深。

en.t: In the past, your love for me was not as deep as your love for another.

units.source_text: 但我的爱情向来专一，钟情只在你一人身上。

en.t: But my own love has always been single-hearted, devoted to you alone.

units.source_text: 我死之后，自有比我优秀的人依照你的愿望再来爱你。

en.t: After I die, someone better than I will surely love you again, just as you desire.

units.source_text: 然而他的爱情决不及我的深。

en.t: Yet his love will never be as deep as mine.

units.source_text: 我单想这一点，也就觉得伤心。”

en.t: When I think only of that, it already breaks my heart."

units.source_text: 说到这里，掩面而泣。

en.t: Having said this much, he covered his face and wept.

units.source_text: 胧月夜红晕满颊，那泛溢着娇羞的脸上流满了眼泪。

en.t: Oborozukiyo's cheeks were flushed, and tears streamed over her face, which was overflowing with bashful shame.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝看了，浑忘了她一切罪过，只觉得可爱可怜。

en.t: Seeing this, Emperor Suzaku forgot all her offenses and felt only that she was dear and pitiable.

units.source_text: 又说：“你怎么不给我生个皇子呢？

en.t: He went on, "Why did you not bear me an imperial prince?

units.source_text: 真是遗憾了！

en.t: It is truly a regret.

units.source_text: 恐怕你将来会替与你宿缘深厚的那个人生的吧！

en.t: I fear that in the future you will bear a child for the one with whom you share such deep karmic ties.

units.source_text: 想到这里，我又觉得遗憾。

en.t: When I think of that, I feel regret all over again.

units.source_text: 因为那人所生的儿子，身份限定，只是一个臣下呢。”

en.t: For a son born to that man would be limited by his status and would be only a subject."

units.source_text: 他竟在想象身后之事，因而说出这话。

en.t: He was even imagining what would happen after his death, and so he spoke these words.

units.source_text: 胧月夜听了，不胜羞惭，又觉得伤心。

en.t: Hearing this, Oborozukiyo was overcome with shame and also felt sorrowful.
